title: Audience Overlap Status
description: Whether a seller disclosed the overlap for one compared audience, carried as overlap_status on each comparison. suppressed mirrors the too_small status of sync_audiences for overlap reads. Experimental (x-status: experimental): sellers implementing audience overlap MUST list media_buy.audience_overlap in experimental_features. A buyer MUST treat an unknown value as suppressed.

enumDescriptions.ready: The overlap is disclosed in the comparison's overlap object.
enumDescriptions.suppressed: The seller withheld the overlap and the comparison carries no overlap object. A seller MUST NOT say which rule withheld it (compared audience below the seller minimum, overlap below minimum_overlap_size, or a near-duplicate audience), because the reason can itself disclose a small count. Buyers MUST NOT read suppressed as zero overlap and MUST NOT retry it without changing an audience.
enumDescriptions.not_ready: A compared audience's matching has not completed, so no overlap can be computed yet. This reflects only the audience status that sync_audiences already reports and carries no count. Buyers retry after sync_audiences reports the audience ready.
